services.name: Residency Program
services.desc: Residency training is self-directed training time for circus professionals to develop skills and create acts in a supportive community environment. Monthly residency is available for professional circus artists, graduates of Esh’s Professional Prep Program, and graduates of national and international full-time professional circus training programs. To inquire about specific hours and studio availability or if you are interested in participating in the residency program, email info@eshcircusarts.com with “Residency” in the subject line. services.name: Private Lessons
services.desc: Private instruction is available for all ages, all levels and in all disciplines offered at Esh. Creative and choreographic coaching is available in addition to skill and technique-based lessons. Come in for a one-off lesson, or schedule regular private instruction. To schedule a private lesson at Esh, please submit a request form. While we will do our best to accommodate all requests, we recommend submitting your request at least a week in advance of the requested lesson date. Please include as much information as possible.
